# Model Results

## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(reticulate)
library(tAge)
library(Biobase)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

## #2 Configure Python and Directories

```{r}
# Install/load the Python dependencies required by tAge
reticulate::py_require(c(
  "joblib",
  "pandas",
  "scikit-learn",
  "numpy"
))
```

## #3 Import Data

### 3.1 Expression Data

```{r}
# Load the scaled gene-expression matrix
# Rows = genes; columns = samples
expression <- read.csv(
  here("data", "raw", "Expression_data_absolute_rodents_Scaled.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

### 3.2 Sample Metadata

```{r}
# Load the metadata table containing the ITP samples and controls
metadata <- read.csv(
  here("results", "table_Zenodo.csv"),
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

## #4 Match Samples Between Expression and Metadata

### 4.1 Identify Common Samples

```{r}
# Keep only samples present in both datasets (Discard non-ITP)
common <- intersect(colnames(expression), rownames(metadata))

paste0(length(common), " samples in common")
```

### 4.2 Align Sample Order

```{r}
# Use the same sample order in both datasets
expression <- expression[, common, drop = FALSE]
metadata <- metadata[common, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(expression), rownames(metadata)))
```

## #5 Create ExpressionSet

```{r}
# Combine expression data and metadata into a Bioconductor ExpressionSet
eset <- make_ExpressionSet(
  expression,
  metadata
)
```

## #6 Align Genes and Subtract Control Expression

### 6.1 Align Genes to the tAge Gene List

```{r}
# Load the genes required by tAge and align the expression matrix
gene_list <- tAge:::load_gene_list()

e <- tAge:::.align_to_gene_list(eset, gene_list)
```

### 6.2 Define Control Subtraction Function

```{r}
# Subtract the gene-wise median expression of the specified controls from every sample in the ExpressionSet, this is done to turn the expression values as relative instead of absolute (because models are scalediff)
control_column <- "Intervention"
control_label  <- "Control"

subtract_controls <- function(eset, control_col, control_lab) {

  mat <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
  meta <- Biobase::pData(eset)

  is_control <- meta[[control_col]] %in% control_lab

  control_median <- apply(
    mat[, is_control, drop = FALSE],
    1,
    median,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  Biobase::exprs(eset) <- mat - control_median

  eset
}
```

### 6.3 Subtract Control Expression

```{r}
# Use all controls as the reference group for expression subtraction
eset_by_group <- list(
  All_Controls = subtract_controls(
    e,
    control_column,
    control_label
  )
)

groups <- list(All_Controls = NULL)
```

### 6.4 Define Expected-Value Centering

```{r}
# Center the expected values by subtracting the median value observed in the control samples
center_controls <- function(values, meta, control_col, control_lab) {

  is_control <- meta[[control_col]] %in% control_lab

  values - median(values[is_control], na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## #7 Locate Model Files

```{r}
# Directory containing the trained tAge model files
model_dir <- here("data", "raw")

model_files <- list.files(
  model_dir,
  pattern = "\\.pkl$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

basename(model_files)
```

## #8 Run the tAge Models

### 8.1 Define Models and Analysis Settings

```{r}
# Run the mortality and chronological models for liver and multitissue
models <- c(
  "Mortality_Rodents_Liver",
  "Chronoage_Rodents_Liver",
  "Mortality_Mouse_Multitissue",
  "Chronoage_Mouse_Multitissue",
  "Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue",
  "Chronoage_Rodents_Multitissue"
)

# Expected metadata variable used for comparison
expected_col <- "Expected_Hazard.log10"

# Control-subtracted expression dataset
group_name <- "All_Controls"

e_sub <- eset_by_group[[group_name]]
meta_sub <- Biobase::pData(e_sub)

# Identify the 11 young controls to exclude from the 150-sample correlation
young_controls <- meta_sub$Intervention == "Control" &
  meta_sub$Age.days < 660

stopifnot(sum(young_controls, na.rm = TRUE) == 11)

# Keep the remaining samples for the 150-sample correlation
keep150 <- !young_controls & !is.na(young_controls)

stopifnot(sum(keep150) == 150)

# Store each model's predictions and statistics
results_list <- list()
```

### 8.2 Predict Sample Values

```{r}
for (model_name in models) {
  
  # Locate the corresponding model file
  model_path <- model_files[
    grepl(model_name, basename(model_files), fixed = TRUE)
  ]
  
  if (length(model_path) != 1) {
    warning(model_name, ": ", length(model_path),
            " matching files; skipped")
    next
  }
  
  # Generate predictions using control-subtracted expression data
  pred <- predict_tAge(
    list(scaled_diff = e_sub),
    list(scaled_diff = model_path),
    species = "mouse",
    mode = "EN"
  )
  
  # Identify the prediction column, excluding standard deviations
  pred_cols <- setdiff(colnames(pred), colnames(meta_sub))
  pred_col <- pred_cols[!grepl("_sd$", pred_cols)][1]
  
  # Match predictions to samples by sample name
  stopifnot(all(colnames(e_sub) %in% rownames(pred)))
  
  obtained <- as.numeric(
    pred[colnames(e_sub), pred_col]
  )
  
  # Center predictions using the median prediction of all controls
  is_control <- meta_sub$Intervention == "Control"
  
  obtained <- obtained - median(
    obtained[is_control],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  # Store centered predictions for each sample
  block <- data.frame(
    Obtained_Centered = obtained,
    row.names = colnames(e_sub)
  )
  
  # Save results for the current model
  names(block) <- paste(
    model_name,
    names(block),
    sep = "__"
  )
  
  results_list[[paste(group_name, model_name, sep = "__")]] <- block
}
```

## #9 Build the Results Table

### 9.1 Align Model Results

```{r}
# Align each model's results with the original metadata sample order
aligned_blocks <- lapply(results_list, function(b) {

  out <- b[rownames(metadata), , drop = FALSE]

  rownames(out) <- NULL

  out
})
```

### 9.2 Center Expected Values and Combine Results

```{r}
# Center expected values for inclusion in the output table
expected_centered <- center_controls(
  as.numeric(metadata[["Expected_Hazard.log10"]]),
  metadata,
  control_column,
  control_label
)

# Combine metadata, centered expected values and model results
results_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(metadata),
  metadata,
  Expected_Hazard.log10_centered = expected_centered,
  " " = NA,
  do.call(cbind, unname(aligned_blocks)),
  check.names = FALSE,
  row.names = NULL
)
```

### 9.3 Export Results

```{r}
# Save the sample-level results and model statistics
write.csv(
  results_table,
  here("results",
    "model_results_chronoage_vs_mortality.csv"
  ),
  na = "",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## #10 Calculate Drug Effects

### 10.1 Define the Multitissue Model Pair

```{r}
# Drug effects are calculated only for the Rodents Multitissue pair
model_pairs <- list(
  Rodents_Multitissue = c(
    "Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue",
    "Chronoage_Rodents_Multitissue"
  )
)

# Identify old controls used as the reference for drug effects
# Young controls are excluded from this comparison
old_controls <- metadata$Intervention == "Control" &
  metadata$Age.days == 660
```

### 10.2 Calculate Effects Within Each Cohort

```{r}
# Consider all interventions other than Control as drug treatments
drug_names <- unique(
  metadata$Intervention[
    !is.na(metadata$Intervention) &
      metadata$Intervention != "Control"
  ]
)

drug_effects <- list()

for (pair_name in names(model_pairs)) {

  for (model_name in model_pairs[[pair_name]]) {

    # Retrieve the predictions stored in the model results
    result_name <- paste(
      group_name,
      model_name,
      sep = "__"
    )

    prediction_col <- paste(
      model_name,
      "Obtained_Centered",
      sep = "__"
    )
    
    predictions <- results_list[[result_name]][[prediction_col]]

    # Ensure predictions are aligned with metadata by sample name
    names(predictions) <- rownames(results_list[[result_name]])

    predictions <- predictions[rownames(metadata)]

    # Calculate one effect per drug, using only matching-cohort controls
    effects <- vapply(drug_names, function(drug) {

      drug_cohorts <- unique(
        metadata$Cohort[metadata$Intervention == drug]
      )

      cohort_effects <- vapply(drug_cohorts, function(cohort) {

        # Samples receiving the drug in this cohort
        treated <- metadata$Intervention == drug &
          metadata$Cohort == cohort

        # Old controls from the same cohort
        controls <- old_controls &
          metadata$Cohort == cohort

        # Cannot calculate an effect without both groups
        if (!any(treated, na.rm = TRUE) ||
            !any(controls, na.rm = TRUE)) {
          return(NA_real_)
        }

        # Drug effect = mean treated prediction - mean old-control prediction
        mean(predictions[treated], na.rm = TRUE) -
          mean(predictions[controls], na.rm = TRUE)

      }, numeric(1))

      # Average cohort-specific effects, giving each cohort equal weight
      if (all(is.na(cohort_effects))) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }

      mean(cohort_effects, na.rm = TRUE)

    }, numeric(1))

    # Store effects for this model
    drug_effects[[model_name]] <- effects
  }
}
```

### 10.3 Create the Drug-Effect Table

```{r}
# One row per drug, with a separate column for each multitissue clock
drug_effects_table <- data.frame(
  Intervention = names(drug_effects[[model_pairs[[1]][1]]]),
  check.names = FALSE
)

for (pair_name in names(model_pairs)) {

  for (model_name in model_pairs[[pair_name]]) {

    # Match effects to interventions by name
    drug_effects_table[[model_name]] <- drug_effects[[model_name]][
      drug_effects_table$Intervention
    ]
  }
}

drug_effects_table$Correlation = NA_real_
drug_effects_table$Correlation[1] = cor(
  drug_effects_table$Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue,
  drug_effects_table$Chronoage_Rodents_Multitissue,
  method = "pearson", use= "complete.obs")
```

### 10.4 Export Drug Effects

```{r}
# Save the drug effects calculated for the two Rodents Multitissue models
write.csv(
  drug_effects_table,
  here(
    "results",
    "drug_effects.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```
